active_phases.name: Smart Mijual Assistant
active_phases.objective: Rebuild the AI 질문 agent from rigid grounded bot into a unified smart assistant modeled on changple5's 일반 대화 agent: gemini-3.7-flash at thinking MID, strip-don't-drop citations, a calculator tool with free prose arithmetic, generous turn ceilings, a security_check prompt-injection guard, naturally conversational behavior, and a chat surface that renders structured content (data rows, calculation results) in the conversation — research changple5 first, then a design round, then DECOMP2 cuts the build.

active_phases.name: Rebrand to 주주의관제탑
active_phases.objective: Replace the product's user-facing identity — name 미주알 → 주주의관제탑 (uniformly unspaced, no latin mark) and the MIJUAL wordmark → the operator's supplied logo plus a derived white variant for the cosmos-dark chrome — across every operator-visible surface: brand binaries, favicon, document title, chrome and ops copy, the signed Korean strings that name the product, and user-visible docs. Code identifiers (src/mijual, MIJUAL_* env vars, X-Mijual-CSRF) are explicitly out of scope. Lands before P4 so the deck, demo video and submission carry the new name.

active_phases.name: Ask agent polish: inline citations and feature cards
active_phases.objective:
Fix two operator-reported defects on the AI 질문 surface. (1) Citation chips break the prose: InlineCitation's always-mounted .quoteWrap is display:grid — a block box in

's inline flow — so every chip forces a line break and a sentence resting on two or more 근거 renders as 「…입니다.[1] ⏎ [2] ⏎ [3]」. Re-cut the ask chip onto the conditionally-mounted absolute-popover anatomy components/Citation.tsx already ships (R10), so chips follow the sentence's period inline and adjacent chips sit side by side — across all three signed placements (프로즈 · 데이터 행 값 · 계산 입력), on the page and the widget, at desktop and ≤767. Server-side numbering is correct and is not touched. (2) The four hard-coded START_CHIPS_KO cards are all read-a-filing questions, exercising only search_events/get_event and leaving calculate, get_portfolio, save_feedback and get_contact invisible. Replace them with a card set — count freed from D11's 'exactly four' by operator instruction — chosen so that clicking the cards one at a time demonstrates every agent capability, keeping R16's layout and the 'card sentence is the question sent' rule. Lands before P4 so the demo video shows both.

active_phases.name: Ship & Deploy
active_phases.objective: Prepare both official 양식 documents (첨부1 공모전 기획서, 첨부2 기능명세서 — English body, Korean headings, not submitted); deploy to the operator's Oracle Cloud box additively behind the shared nginx edge and Cloudflare at jujutower.com; set up SEO; ship the email D-day notification channel; and add a production smoke suite with uptime monitoring.
